# MJ Innovations FZ LLC
> AI-powered video surveillance platform. Where Innovation Meets Intelligence.

MJ Innovations FZ LLC is a Dubai-based AI surveillance company that transforms existing camera infrastructure into an intelligent, autonomous security layer. The platform detects threats, analyses behaviour, and dispatches alerts in under 300 milliseconds — without replacing a single camera.

The company is early-stage, production-ready, and actively seeking first pilot partners across the MENA region. All deployments are privacy-first: footage never leaves the client's infrastructure unless explicitly configured otherwise.

## Core Product

MJ Innovations AI Surveillance Platform — a modular, multi-model AI system that plugs into any existing CCTV or IP camera infrastructure and adds real-time detection, behaviour analytics, forensic search, and sub-second alert dispatch.

**MJ Device X** — a plug-and-play edge AI processor that physically connects to any camera and runs the full MJ AI stack locally, offline, with no cloud dependency.
